headline: Phalhala or Bust: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Phalhala or Bust is projected #12 of 16 with a 553.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Ashton Jeanty, Sam LaPorta, and Rome Odunze. The immediate priority is improving the QB slot without weakening that core. On the website's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #15 of 16 with a 700.8 dynasty power score.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Power Rankings webpage D-AVI ladder: 65% canonical franchise D-AVI plus 35% starting-lineup C-AVI, with the championship-rank placement floor

latest_trade.summary: On May 3, Phalhala or Bust traded with Ravens Regime and acquired Michael Wilson, 2026 Round 2 (Ravens Regime), 2026 Round 4 (Badland Banditos) while sending Romeo Doubs. Michael Wilson is now the current WR starter at 62.4 C-AVI and 82.4 D-AVI; The deal added 2 draft assets.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the QB slot above C.J. Stroud's 47.8 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 59.0 C-AVI would directly attack the 11.20-point projected gap to Gringo’s Goblins.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
